summary: An excellent investment opportunity, this two-bedroom mid terraced property is ideally suited to investors looking to expand their portfolio. Offering an attractive potential rental yield of approximately 11%, the property presents the opportunity for a strong return on investment.
description:
Situated in a convenient location, this two bedroom mid terraced property offers an excellent opportunity for first time buyers, couples or investors alike offering an 11% yield. The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hallway, spacious living room and fitted kitchen and bathroom with separate toilet to the ground floor. To the first floor there are two spacious bedrooms.

LIVING ROOM A spacious living room offering ample space for a range of living room furniture, creating a comfortable and welcoming area.

KITCHEN A fitted kitchen comprising a range of wall and base units providing ample storage and worktop space. There is plumbing for a washing machine and a window overlooking the rear yard, allowing for natural light.

WC To the rear of the property is a separate WC, conveniently positioned away from the main living accommodation.

BATHROOM The ground floor bathroom is fitted with a panelled bath and wash hand basin, with space for everyday bathroom essentials. Positioned conveniently off the main living accommodation.

BEDROOM A spacious master bedroom offering ample room for a double bed and a range of bedroom furniture. The room benefits from a window overlooking the front aspect.

BEDROOM A well proportioned second bedroom situated to the rear of the property, offering space for bedroom furniture.
